key_insight: A differentially private score estimator achieves nearly matching minimax error bounds, characterizing the privacy–accuracy trade-off and enabling private diffusion modeling.
engineering_relevance: The resulting diffusion model has a privacy guarantee independent of its number of denoising steps and nearly minimax-optimal expected total variation error with appropriate discretization.
method: Represent scores using quadratic B-splines and sample via the exponential mechanism.
Implement private estimation with projected Langevin Monte Carlo in runtime polynomial in sample size.
Prove error upper bounds and nearly matching private minimax lower bounds.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets supporting the theory, but provides no numerical results.
watch_item: The guarantees assume sub-Gaussian distributions with locally Hölder-continuous scores; polynomial runtime alone does not establish practical scalability.
paper_title: Differentially Private Score Estimation with Applications to Score-Based Generative Models
